MORE:
Pursuant to regulation 30, 33 and other applicable Regulations of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and with reference to captioned subject, we wish to inform that, the Board of Directors of Sankhya Infotech Limited (hereinafter referred to as 'the Company'), have at their meeting held on Thursday, August 13, 2026, inter-alia, considered and approved, along with other business items, the following:
1. Un-audited financial results (standalone) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 along with Statutory Auditors Limited Review Report thereon. A copy of the 'Limited Review Report' issued by M/s. N G Rao & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Statutory Auditors of the Company together with the Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 are also enclosed herewith.
NEWSSUB: Unudited Financial Results For Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
